title: Worst experience ever
text: Worst experience ever. I used the bowls for a few days and found them have some defective. and I contacted the seller. The seller ignored my inquire. The quality is so bad and the seller is very unprofessional. These bowls look nothing like the product pictures. Stay away from this bad seller!

product_metadata.title: Selamica Porcelain 18oz Bowls Set - Set of 6, ceramic bowls for Pasta, Salad, Cereal, Assorted Colors
features: OVAL SHAPE WITH CLEAN LINES DESIGN - These bowls were designed with a unique oval shape and have a smooth finish and modern look. They look like a boat and fun to have at the table. And turquoise bowls are perfect for displaying the delicious foods.

MULTIPLE USES BOWL SET - These porcelain bowls about 6" wide and 2.6" deep and holds a maximum of 20 oz. That is a good size and deep enough for salad, pasta, cereal, soup, serving side dishes, or for any use you can imagine.
EASY TO STACK AND CLEAN - These porcelain bowl set can stack evenly to conserve cabinet or counter space. The bowls with a surface smooth glaze will make it easy to clean and have no stains.

STURDY AND WELL-MADE - Each bowl is made of premium food-grade porcelain. Made with solid porcelain also means you can use them in the microwave! Dishwasher safe, also fit in the oven and freezer great.
BEST GIFT FOR FRIENDS AND FAMILIES - The bowls are safely packaged to avoid breakage during delivery. These bowls are warming gift choice for housewarmings, Mother’s Day, Christmas, etc.
